guides.title: Simple Moving Average
guides.concept: Arithmetic mean of selected prices over N completed bars. This is a trend study; it transforms historical source observations instead of independently predicting future trades.
guides.formula: SMA(N,t) = SUM(Close[k] for k=t-N+1...t) / N, using N completed valid closing prices; price units.
guides.whyUse: This can help a learner describe trend conditions, ask better chart questions and compare a setup with a documented reference, not create an automatic entry.
